body.prompt: An older Korean man in his seventies sitting alone on a small apartment balcony at night, looking at an old faded family photograph in his hands, lonely and tired, city lights behind. Same painterly cinematic oil-painting texture and fine film grain, but a cool desaturated blue-grey palette with only one small warm light, horizontal 16:9 widescreen film frame, main subject in the middle band of the frame, nothing important in the top and bottom eighth of the frame, faces clearly lit. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no readable screens, no watermark, no brands anywhere.
